# Sigrid documentation

- Assume cloud-based Sigrid unless the user says otherwise. The "Sigrid On-Premise" pages only apply to on-premise installations.
- The Markdown source of these pages is in the `docs/` directory of https://github.com/Software-Improvement-Group/sigridci.
